hyperscaler_capability_matrix.closed_gap: Tenant-affine stream partition admission no longer allows an empty partition key.

facets.F1_correctness: admit_streaming_partition now rejects missing partition keys for every ordered strategy, including TenantAffine and KeyHash.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 unit coverage asserts TenantAffine rejects blank keys, accepts explicit tenant keys, and preserves existing KeyHash/RoundRobin/AdaptiveLoad behavior.
facets.F3_maintainability: The guard reuses StreamingPartitionStrategy::is_ordered instead of duplicating a second strategy list.
facets.F4_compatibility: The public function signature, enum variants, BUCK targets, Cargo manifests, and generated artifacts are unchanged.
facets.F5_security: Tenant-affine streams fail closed before adapter execution when no tenant partition key is supplied.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant records, personal data, customer data, or secrets are processed or persisted by this change.
facets.F7_operability: Operators and future adapters receive the existing MissingPartitionKey error instead of silently admitting an unscoped ordered stream.
facets.F8_performance: The added check is a trim/is_empty check on an admission path and does not affect hot record routing.
facets.F9_compliance: No hand-edited generated artifacts, dependencies, Cargo manifests, workflows, or root-hub specs are changed; ADR-0562 cites the exact evidence path so cloud-ci total-accounting resolves the new evidence bundle as justified.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of one Rust source file, the ADR evidence citation, and this evidence file; no data migration or runtime state mutation is introduced.
facets.F11_observability: Strategy names remain stable labels; the failure mode is explicitly represented as MissingPartitionKey.
facets.F13_migration: Supports owned-stack data-plane migration by ensuring provider-neutral partition admission preserves tenant-affinity semantics before adapters are wired.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected broader tenant/account abstractions for this first PR; the smallest enforceable isolation improvement is key admission for the existing TenantAffine strategy.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: This closes a concrete red tenant-isolation gap without touching root-hub specs, workflows, dependency manifests, generated faces, or runtime adapters.
